candidates.title: Structured Transforms for Low-Overhead Quantization of Language Models
candidates.reason: Kashin分解のdense random transformを符号ランダム化DCTへ置換してO(N log N)化し、2-bit factor codeをnative 2-bit hardware向けに構造化。

candidates.title: KBBQ: A Predictive Noise Law and the Limits of Spectrum Flattening in FP4 Quantization
candidates.reason: FP4量子化noiseのclosed-form理論とtransform上限を導き、追加deployment-time計算なしのKBBQを提案。4モデル・2 FP4 formatのW4A4で既存最良法を上回る。

candidates.title: Scaling Post-Training Ternarisation to Qwen3-8B Capability Retention, Reproduction, Lossless Packing, and Packed Execution
candidates.reason: Qwen3-8Bのpost-training ternarisationをlossless packingと直接packed executionまで実測し15.52 token/s・7.35GiBを報告。
